rationale: The original TRIHEP3 plan specifies aggregate behavioral scoring at months 6 and 12. The paper and two registries do not supply an apathy-item result. Safflower processing remains unspecified and the comparison was in Huntington disease.

The French pediatric supplement trial NCT06594536 remains recruiting with no results. The independent Tehran methylphenidate adjunct report provides author-abstract effects only. The separate Parkinson sulforaphane trial NCT05084365 has unknown status without outcomes. No verified raw-broccoli attention comparison is available.

The short mitochondrial study specifies grapeseed oil in its official registration. The eight-week insomnia study uses an unnamed oil and has no results. The primary Terauchi abstract gives a within-arm change for seed extract tablets. The original placebo-relative sleep estimate and the insomnia-trial oil identity remain unavailable.
